products: Land stewardship and education are at the heart of the project. We want to create space for land owners to learn about how to be good stewards.
results: This has been a steep learning curve for us. Knowing when to tend and when to mend requires lots of observation, excellent information and a long term view. By changing our relationship to the land- caring for it rather than taking from it- we hope to contribute to climate resiliency. We plan to build a learning space. We look forward to sharing our experience with other landowners and sharing our space to support people to feel connected to nature- through forest bathing and walking through our living laboratory.
quote: Learning and sharing how to be good land stewards through regeneration.
